results.title: UNDP, KP discuss development priorities and future cooperation
results.description: PESHAWAR - UNDP Pakistan Resident Representative Samuel Rizk met Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Secretary Dr Fakhre Alam to discuss the province’s development priorities, progress on ongoing projects supported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and prospects for future cooperation.

results.title: US Suspects Iran in Dozens of Tanker Cyberattacks
results.description: U.S. authorities are investigating Iran's potential involvement in dozens of cyberattacks against energy tankers amid concerns that Tehran is expanding its war against the U.S. and Israel beyond the Middle East.
